begin
  return query
  with candidate as (
    select d.id
    from public.knowledge_documents d
    where d.source_type = 'file'
      and d.status = 'processing'
      and coalesce(d.metadata->>'ingestion_state','') in ('queued','processing')
      and (nullif(d.metadata->>'retry_after','') is null or (d.metadata->>'retry_after')::timestamptz <= now())
      and (d.ingestion_lease_until is null or d.ingestion_lease_until < now())
    order by d.created_at asc
    for update skip locked
    limit 1
  )
  update public.knowledge_documents d
  set ingestion_attempt = d.ingestion_attempt + 1,
      ingestion_lease_until = now() + make_interval(secs => greatest(30, least(coalesce(p_lease_seconds,180), 900))),
      metadata = jsonb_set(
        jsonb_set(coalesce(d.metadata,'{}'::jsonb), '{ingestion_state}', '"processing"'::jsonb, true),
        '{last_attempt_at}', to_jsonb(now()), true
      ),
      updated_at = now()
  from candidate c
  where d.id = c.id
  returning d.*;
end;

begin
  update public.knowledge_documents
  set status = case when p_success then 'ready' when ingestion_attempt >= 3 then 'failed' else 'processing' end,
      ingestion_error_code = case when p_success then null else left(coalesce(p_error_code,'ingestion_failed'),80) end,
      ingestion_lease_until = null,
      page_count = case when p_success then greatest(coalesce(p_page_count,0),0) else page_count end,
      metadata = jsonb_set(
        jsonb_set(coalesce(metadata,'{}'::jsonb), '{ingestion_state}', to_jsonb(case when p_success then 'ready' when ingestion_attempt >= 3 then 'failed' else 'queued' end), true),
        '{processed_at}', to_jsonb(now()), true
      ) || case when not p_success and ingestion_attempt < 3 then
        jsonb_build_object('retry_after', to_jsonb(now() + make_interval(secs => least(300, 15 * power(2, ingestion_attempt))))) 
      else '{}'::jsonb end,
      updated_at = now()
  where id = p_document_id
    and owner_user_id = p_owner_user_id
    and source_type = 'file'
    and status = 'processing'
    and ingestion_lease_until > now();
  return found;
end;

with scoped as (
    select
      model_key,
      provider_key,
      status,
      input_tokens,
      output_tokens,
      coalesce(actual_cost, estimated_cost, 0) as cost,
      latency_ms,
      created_at
    from public.llm_usage
    where user_id = p_user_id
      and created_at >= p_since
      and created_at < p_until
  ),
  summary as (
    select
      count(*)::bigint as total_requests,
      coalesce(sum(input_tokens + output_tokens), 0)::bigint as total_tokens,
      count(*) filter (where status in ('succeeded', 'completed'))::bigint as successful_requests,
      count(*) filter (where status in ('failed', 'error'))::bigint as failed_requests,
      coalesce(sum(cost), 0)::numeric as total_cost,
      coalesce(round(avg(latency_ms) filter (where latency_ms is not null)), 0)::bigint as average_latency_ms
    from scoped
  ),
  model_rows as (
    select
      model_key,
      provider_key,
      count(*)::bigint as requests,
      coalesce(sum(input_tokens + output_tokens), 0)::bigint as tokens,
      count(*) filter (where status in ('succeeded', 'completed'))::bigint as successful_requests,
      coalesce(sum(cost), 0)::numeric as cost
    from scoped
    group by model_key, provider_key
  ),
  day_rows as (
    select
      date_trunc('day', created_at) as day,
      count(*)::bigint as requests,
      coalesce(sum(input_tokens + output_tokens), 0)::bigint as tokens,
      coalesce(sum(cost), 0)::numeric as cost
    from scoped
    group by date_trunc('day', created_at)
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'summary', (select to_jsonb(summary) from summary),
    'by_model', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(model_rows) order by requests desc, model_key asc)
      from model_rows
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'by_day', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'day', day::date,
          'requests', requests,
          'tokens', tokens,
          'cost', cost
        ) order by day asc
      )
      from day_rows
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'period', jsonb_build_object('since', p_since, 'until', p_until)
  );

declare
  v_limit integer := least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 50), 1), 100);
begin
  if p_user_id is null then
    raise exception 'customer_user_id_required' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  if (p_cursor_updated_at is null) <> (p_cursor_id is null) then
    raise exception 'pagination_cursor_invalid' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  return query
  with accessible_workspace_ids as (
    select w.id
    from public.workspaces as w
    where w.owner_user_id = p_user_id
      and w.status = 'active'

    union

    select w.id
    from public.workspace_members as wm
    join public.workspaces as w on w.id = wm.workspace_id
    where wm.user_id = p_user_id
      and wm.status = 'active'
      and w.status = 'active'
  )
  select
    w.id,
    w.name,
    w.slug,
    w.owner_user_id,
    w.status,
    w.created_at,
    w.updated_at
  from public.workspaces as w
  join accessible_workspace_ids as accessible on accessible.id = w.id
  where p_cursor_updated_at is null
     or (w.updated_at, w.id) < (p_cursor_updated_at, p_cursor_id)
  order by w.updated_at desc, w.id desc
  limit (v_limit + 1);
end;

declare
  v_items jsonb;
begin
  if p_limit < 1 or p_limit > 100 then
    raise exception 'browser_profile_retention_limit_invalid' using errcode='22023';
  end if;

  with candidates as (
    select id, user_id, profile_retention_after
    from public.moreai_browser_sessions
    where status in ('closed','expired')
      and profile_retention_after <= now()
      and profile_deleted_at is null
      and profile_retention_notified_at is null
    order by profile_retention_after asc, id asc
    for update skip locked
    limit p_limit
  ), updated as (
    update public.moreai_browser_sessions as sessions
    set profile_retention_notified_at=now()
    from candidates
    where sessions.id=candidates.id
    returning sessions.id, sessions.user_id, sessions.profile_retention_after
  ), events as (
    insert into public.moreai_browser_session_events(
      session_id,user_id,event_type,metadata
    )
    select id,user_id,'profile_retention_eligible',
      jsonb_build_object('retention_after',profile_retention_after,'retention_days',30)
    from updated
    returning session_id
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'session_id',updated.id,
    'user_id',updated.user_id,
    'retention_after',updated.profile_retention_after
  )), '[]'::jsonb)
  into v_items
  from updated;

  return jsonb_build_object('items',v_items,'retention_days',30);
end;

declare
  v_items jsonb;
begin
  if p_limit is null or p_limit < 1 or p_limit > 100 then
    raise exception 'browser_profile_retention_limit_invalid' using errcode='22023';
  end if;

  with candidates as (
    select id, user_id, profile_retention_after, profile_retention_notified_at
    from public.moreai_browser_sessions
    where status in ('closed','expired')
      and profile_retention_after <= now()
      and profile_deleted_at is null
      and (
        profile_retention_claimed_at is null
        or profile_retention_claimed_at <= now() - interval '5 minutes'
      )
    order by profile_retention_after asc, id asc
    for update skip locked
    limit p_limit
  ), updated as (
    update public.moreai_browser_sessions as sessions
    set
      profile_retention_claimed_at=now(),
      profile_retention_notified_at=coalesce(sessions.profile_retention_notified_at, now())
    from candidates
    where sessions.id=candidates.id
    returning sessions.id, sessions.user_id, sessions.profile_retention_after
  ), events as (
    insert into public.moreai_browser_session_events(
      session_id,user_id,event_type,metadata
    )
    select updated.id,updated.user_id,'profile_retention_eligible',
      jsonb_build_object('retention_after',updated.profile_retention_after,'retention_days',30)
    from updated
    join candidates on candidates.id=updated.id
    where candidates.profile_retention_notified_at is null
    returning session_id
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'session_id',updated.id,
    'user_id',updated.user_id,
    'retention_after',updated.profile_retention_after
  )), '[]'::jsonb)
  into v_items
  from updated;

  return jsonb_build_object('items',v_items,'retention_days',30,'claim_lease_seconds',300);
end;

begin
  if p_worker_id is null or p_worker_id !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{8,128}$'
     or p_limit is null or p_limit < 1 or p_limit > 25 then
    raise exception 'takeover_command_claim_payload_invalid' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  -- Expire queued commands whose one-time grant or owning session is no longer usable.
  update public.moreai_browser_takeover_commands c
     set status = 'expired',
         encrypted_command = '[expired]',
         finished_at = pg_catalog.now(),
         lease_expires_at = null,
         error_code = 'takeover_grant_or_session_expired'
   where c.status = 'queued'
     and not exists (
       select 1
         from public.moreai_browser_takeover_grants g
         join public.moreai_browser_sessions s
           on s.id = g.session_id and s.user_id = g.user_id
        where g.id = c.grant_id
          and g.session_id = c.session_id
          and g.user_id = c.user_id
          and g.consumed_at is null
          and g.revoked_at is null
          and g.expires_at > pg_catalog.now()
          and s.status = 'active'
          and s.expires_at > pg_catalog.now()
     );

  -- A worker may have sent the browser action before losing its lease.
  -- The outcome cannot be safely inferred, so terminalize rather than replay.
  update public.moreai_browser_takeover_commands c
     set status = 'failed',
         encrypted_command = '[outcome_unknown]',
         finished_at = pg_catalog.now(),
         lease_expires_at = null,
         error_code = 'worker_lease_expired_outcome_unknown'
   where c.status = 'processing'
     and c.lease_expires_at is not null
     and c.lease_expires_at <= pg_catalog.now();

  return query
  with candidates as (
    select c.id
      from public.moreai_browser_takeover_commands c
      join public.moreai_browser_sessions s
        on s.id = c.session_id and s.user_id = c.user_id
      join public.moreai_browser_takeover_grants g
        on g.id = c.grant_id and g.session_id = c.session_id and g.user_id = c.user_id
     where c.status = 'queued'
       and c.attempts < 5
       and s.status = 'active'
       and s.expires_at > pg_catalog.now()
       and g.consumed_at is null
       and g.revoked_at is null
       and g.expires_at > pg_catalog.now()
     order by c.created_at, c.id
     for update of c skip locked
     limit p_limit
  )
  update public.moreai_browser_takeover_commands c
     set status = 'processing',
         claimed_by = p_worker_id,
         lease_expires_at = pg_catalog.now() + interval '45 seconds',
         claimed_at = pg_catalog.now(),
         attempts = c.attempts + 1
    from candidates
   where c.id = candidates.id
  returning c.*;
end;

begin
  if p_worker_id is null or p_worker_id !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{8,128}$'
     or p_limit is null or p_limit < 1 or p_limit > 10 then
    raise exception 'browser_preview_claim_payload_invalid' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  update public.moreai_browser_preview_requests p
     set status = 'failed',
         error_code = 'worker_lease_expired_outcome_unknown',
         finished_at = pg_catalog.now(),
         lease_expires_at = null
   where p.status = 'processing'
     and p.lease_expires_at is not null
     and p.lease_expires_at <= pg_catalog.now();

  update public.moreai_browser_preview_requests p
     set status = 'expired',
         error_code = 'browser_session_or_run_no_longer_eligible',
         finished_at = pg_catalog.now(),
         lease_expires_at = null
   where p.status = 'queued'
     and not exists (
       select 1
         from public.moreai_browser_sessions s
         join public.agent_runs r
           on r.id = p.run_id and r.user_id = p.user_id
        where s.id = p.session_id
          and s.user_id = p.user_id
          and (s.run_id = p.run_id or s.last_run_id = p.run_id)
          and s.status = 'active'
          and s.expires_at > pg_catalog.now()
          and r.status in ('running','succeeded')
     );

  return query
  with candidates as (
    select p.id
      from public.moreai_browser_preview_requests p
      join public.moreai_browser_sessions s
        on s.id = p.session_id and s.user_id = p.user_id
      join public.agent_runs r
        on r.id = p.run_id and r.user_id = p.user_id
     where p.status = 'queued'
       and p.attempts < 3
       and (s.run_id = p.run_id or s.last_run_id = p.run_id)
       and s.status = 'active'
       and s.expires_at > pg_catalog.now()
       and r.status in ('running','succeeded')
     order by p.created_at, p.id
     for update of p skip locked
     limit p_limit
  )
  update public.moreai_browser_preview_requests p
     set status = 'processing',
         claimed_by = p_worker_id,
         lease_expires_at = pg_catalog.now() + interval '60 seconds',
         claimed_at = pg_catalog.now(),
         attempts = p.attempts + 1
    from candidates
   where p.id = candidates.id
  returning p.*;
end;

declare
  v_row public.moreai_browser_preview_requests%rowtype;
begin
  if p_request_id is null
     or p_worker_id is null
     or p_worker_id !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{8,128}$'
     or p_status not in ('succeeded','failed')
     or (p_status = 'succeeded' and p_artifact_id is null) then
    raise exception 'browser_preview_finish_payload_invalid' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  update public.moreai_browser_preview_requests p
     set status = p_status,
         artifact_id = case when p_status = 'succeeded' then p_artifact_id else null end,
         error_code = case when p_status = 'failed'
                           then left(coalesce(p_error_code, 'browser_preview_failed'), 100) else null end,
         finished_at = pg_catalog.now(),
         lease_expires_at = null
   where p.id = p_request_id
     and p.status = 'processing'
     and p.claimed_by = p_worker_id
     and p.lease_expires_at > pg_catalog.now()
     and exists (
       select 1
         from public.moreai_browser_sessions s
        where s.id = p.session_id
          and s.user_id = p.user_id
          and (s.run_id = p.run_id or s.last_run_id = p.run_id)
          and s.status = 'active'
          and s.expires_at > pg_catalog.now()
     )
     and (
       p_status = 'failed'
       or exists (
         select 1
           from public.artifacts a
          where a.id = p_artifact_id
            and a.user_id = p.user_id
            and a.run_id = p.run_id
            and a.mime_type = 'image/png'
       )
     )
  returning p.* into v_row;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'browser_preview_worker_lease_or_artifact_invalid' using errcode = '40001';
  end if;

  return pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
    'id', v_row.id, 'status', v_row.status, 'artifact_id', v_row.artifact_id
  );
end;
